building.school.desc: Trains all residents at once: each school (up to three) makes them tougher and stronger.

tutorial.skip_confirm: Skip the tutorial? You can do it later in settings.
tutorial.title: First Shift
tutorial.step1: This is a closed-off city. Tap any block to place the Command Center there.
tutorial.step2: A resident is ready. Swipe across the blocks next to the center: residents will go and clear them.
tutorial.step3: Empty blocks mean nothing is nearby. Then residents clear the neighbors by themselves.
tutorial.step4: A number counts only the 8 blocks around it. Tap it: only one neighbor is closed, so the nest is there. The scanner marked it red.
tutorial.step5: Tap both numbers. They share one closed neighbor, and the nest can only be there. So the other block is safe: the scanner put a tick on it.
tutorial.step6: Before going near a nest you need defenders. Build a Rescue School.
tutorial.step7: The squad is ready. Tap the red mark to open the nest. It is not a loss, it is the start of a fight.
tutorial.step8: The defender won and took the adaptant's arm. The more trophies, the stronger they get.
tutorial.step9: A light-blue number means a find nearby. Clear a block next to it and open the cache.
tutorial.final.title: You are ready for the shift
tutorial.final.line1: A number shows how many of that are nearby.
tutorial.final.line2: A tick means the block is safe.
tutorial.final.line3: A red mark means danger. Open it when your squad is ready.
